{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float by removing commas and casting
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99 revenue
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for converted customers only
df_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out missing age (customer_age == -1)
df_converted_filtered = df_converted[df_converted['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = df_converted_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted}")"}
